title: Mutiny Streams Accidentally on Prime Video Before Release
text:
Jason Statham's new action film 'Mutiny' was briefly available on Prime Video in the US. The accidental streaming raised questions about hidden content, but the movie ends definitively without a post-credits scene. Reviews are mixed, with praise for Statham but criticism for overall execution.
Jason Statham's upcoming action movie ' Mutiny' was accidentally streamed on Prime Video for an hour, just two days before its theatrical release. The film, directed by Jean-François Richet, stars Statham as Cole Reed, a former special forces operative framed for murder.
While the leak was quickly corrected, it raised questions about a post-credits scene. However, the movie ends cleanly after 95 minutes with no additional scenes or sequel teases. Early reviews are mixed, praising Statham's performance but noting the film doesn't fully meet expectations
